rules.title: On-demand matching grace
rules.statement: Cancellation within 3 minutes of matching is not chargeable. Driver arrival does not shorten the guaranteed rider grace.

sources.exact_text:
On-demand Trip - Rider Cancellation & Waiting Time Policy Statement
All cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable.
Rider will be charged a Cancellation Fee of $6.61* if:
Rider cancels after 3 minutes of matching OR
The driver presses “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to arrive at the pick-up point and cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)
Riders are guaranteed 3 minutes of grace period from the time of match and/or 15 minutes before scheduled time for Advance Trip Request before the Cancellation Fee kicks in.

conditions: Cancellation within 3 minutes of matching is not chargeable.
Driver arrival does not shorten the guaranteed rider grace.
limits: Do not substitute arrival time for matching time.
Precision and event ordering must be established.
rules.interpretation_proposed: Compare matching elapsed time; exact 180-second cancellation remains within grace.
unresolved_questions: Resolve conflicting/missing timestamps without rounding them into eligibility.
rules.why_relevant: Three-minute grace from matching; an early driver arrival does not shorten it.

rules.title: Driver cancellation for on-demand rider no-show
rules.statement: Driver presses arrival, waits more than 3 minutes at pickup, rider does not arrive, driver cancels, no trip completion. Rider matching grace remains relevant. Principal rider policy states SGD 6.61 cancellation fee.

sources.exact_text:
On-demand Trip - Rider Cancellation & Waiting Time Policy Statement
All cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable.
Rider will be charged a Cancellation Fee of $6.61* if:
Rider cancels after 3 minutes of matching OR
The driver presses “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to arrive at the pick-up point and cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)
Riders are guaranteed 3 minutes of grace period from the time of match and/or 15 minutes before scheduled time for Advance Trip Request before the Cancellation Fee kicks in.

Drivers are only allowed to indicate arrival and impose the Waiting Time Fee only if he/she:
Is at the pick-up location according to GPS data
AND
Has waited for more than 3 mins
Otherwise, you will not be charged the $6.61 Waiting Time Fee if any of the above are not fulfilled.
Nonetheless, do reach out to us if you feel you have been charged unfairly or wrongly, and we’ll be happy to assist you.

conditions: Driver presses arrival, waits more than 3 minutes at pickup, rider does not arrive, driver cancels, no trip completion.

No-show and completed-trip waiting are different events.

rules.interpretation_proposed: Evaluate time only after factual arrival is supported. Do not invent a radius or infer no-show from missing chat.
unresolved_questions: Arrival tolerance and exception handling need policy-owner confirmation.

rules.title: Fixed fare and preferred route agreement
rules.statement: Fare based on booked endpoints; driver may choose efficient GPS route. Rider preferred route should be mutually agreed before travel.

sources.exact_text:
The trip fare is fixed based on pick-up and drop-off points, hence the driver may decide to take the most efficient route according to GPS.
If you have a preferred route, you may recommend this to your driver and reach a mutual agreement before you go.

Drop your driver a message to acknowledge the upcoming trip and add in any details to help them navigate to your specific pick up point better. Furthermore, if you have additional requests such as going via a preferred travel route, do communicate this with the driver and come to a mutual agreement prior to starting the trip. This will help facilitate a smoother ride!

The trip fare is fixed based on pick-up and drop-off points. So you may decide to take the fastest or most efficient route based on your GPS.
However, if you do not mind taking the route suggested by the rider, agreeing and travelling via the rider's suggested route may result in a happier ride!

Fares quoted for our services are generally fixed, except for RydeTAXI. However, please note that there may be additional charges such as tolls that could occur during your trip.
For a detailed breakdown of your fare, please refer to your receipt. All fees and surcharges will be clearly listed for your reference.

conditions: Fare based on booked endpoints; driver may choose efficient GPS route.
Rider preferred route should be mutually agreed before travel.
limits: A request alone is not mutual agreement.
A longer route is not by itself a published refund formula.
Destination edits and legitimate ERP can affect final total.
rules.interpretation_proposed: Assess agreement and fare components separately; do not invent a deviation percentage or full-refund entitlement.
unresolved_questions: No universal route damages/refund formula identified.
rules.why_relevant: Fixed fare by endpoints; driver chooses route; preferred route needs agreement before travel.

rules.title: Destination edit eligibility and acceptance
rules.statement: Inform driver and submit edit in app. Driver acceptance required; nonresponse causes decline. Acceptance recalculates fare and updates route.

sources.exact_text:
We are excited to announce the full rollout of a new feature that allows you to update your trip destination during a ride. Please note the following guidelines:
Inform Your Driver First – Before changing your destination, kindly notify your driver. If the new destination significantly increases the trip’s distance or duration, the driver may not be able to accommodate the change.
Driver Acceptance – After updating your destination in the app, please let your driver know. They will have a limited time to accept the change. If they do not respond within this period, your request will be automatically declined.
Fare Adjustment – Once the driver accepts, your trip fare will be recalculated, and your route will be updated to the new destination.
*RydePOOL, RydeTAXI & Multiple stop bookings are not allowed to make any changes in destination.
Effective 17 Oct 2025

The driver receives an edit request pop-up.
The driver can accept or reject the request.
If the driver accepts, they receive a notification, and the add/edit destination fee is reflected on their receipt.
If the driver rejects, the previous trip details remain, and no fee is reflected on their receipt.

limits: Rejection preserves previous trip details.

rules.interpretation_proposed: Apply accepted edit only after eligibility and acceptance are evidenced.
unresolved_questions: Acceptance timeout duration not stated here; do not import pilot timing.

rules.title: Driver compensation is a separate monetary subject
rules.statement: Driver-facing policy names SGD 4.50 compensation; rider-facing policy uses other gross amounts.

sources.exact_text:
On-Demand Trip
A Cancellation Fee compensates drivers for the time and effort they spend getting to the rider’s location.
A Waiting Time Fee allows our drivers to be compensated by riders for the time spent waiting at a pickup location.
All cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable.
Driver will receive a Cancellation Fee of $4.50* if:
Rider cancels after 3 minutes of matching
Driver may charge a Waiting Time Fee of $4.50 at the end of the trip if:
The driver pressed “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for rider to arrive at pick-up point and  cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion), OR
The driver pressed “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for rider to board, and continues the trip  (Rider boards and driver completes trip).

Please let us know why you are cancelling.
Drivers will receive a $4.50 cancellation fee automatically if they cancel after >3 minutes of waiting.

Rider will be charged a Cancellation Fee of $6.61* if:
Rider cancels after 3 minutes of matching OR
The driver presses “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to arrive at the pick-up point and cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)
Riders may be charged a Waiting Time Fee of $5 at the end of the trip if:
The driver presses “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to board, and continues the trip (Rider boards and driver completes trip).

conditions: Driver-facing policy names SGD 4.50 compensation; rider-facing policy uses other gross amounts.
limits: Different payee amounts need not be contradictory.
No-show naming and completed waiting amounts remain inconsistent.
rules.interpretation_proposed: Never use one undifferentiated fee_amount for rider debit and driver payout.
rules.why_relevant: Rider charge and driver payout ($4.50) are different amounts.

sources.exact_text:
Riders may be charged a Waiting Time Fee of $5 at the end of the trip if:
The driver presses “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to board, and continues the trip (Rider boards and driver completes trip).

Drivers are only allowed to indicate arrival and impose the Waiting Time Fee only if he/she:
Is at the pick-up location according to GPS data
AND
Has waited for more than 3 mins
Otherwise, you will not be charged the $6.61 Waiting Time Fee if any of the above are not fulfilled.

If you feel that you have been unfairly charged for a Waiting Fee, you may submit a fee waiver request via RydeHELP in our app within 30 days of the trip* and we will review your eligibility for a refund.
If you are eligible, we will issue you a voucher** with a unique code worth $5.00 as a refund for the incurred Waiting Charges. Please be mindful to top up your Ryde wallet using the voucher code given to you within the expiry period.

conflicts.resolution: Team reading (30 September 2026): the $5 Waiting Time Fee and the $6.61 figure are one fee quoted two ways. $5.00 is the fee before charges; $6.61 is what a rider paying cashless is charged: $5.00, plus the $1.15 platform fee with 9% GST ($1.25), plus the 1.96% + $0.24 cashless transaction fee (about $0.36), per P40. The arrival FAQ calls $6.61 the 'Waiting Time Fee', and the $6.61 on the fee page carries the footnote. A completed-trip waiting fee charged at $5.00, or at $6.61 on a cashless payment, matches the pages; the $6.61 cancellation fee carries the same footnote.
evidence: help-centre/text/23534478435353.txt lines 10-11 (Waiting Time Fee of $5) and 21 (the footnote, quoted by P40)
conflicts.what_would_reopen: A Ryde receipt or RydeHELP reply showing a different waiting-fee amount, or a cash payment charged $6.61 as the waiting fee.
conflicts.decided_by: The team, approved by the user on 30 September 2026; a team reading, not a Ryde statement.
